rejected_approach_disposition: Both candidate branches are now moot and should be left alone (no authority/need to delete): (1) origin/codex/v4-f50-remedy-lead-honesty — superseded in effect since its content is already on main via PR #1347; safe to leave as a stale, functionally-duplicate branch. (2) origin/par/night-F-50 (86062faa0) — was the formally ratified candidate per results/ingested/F-50.{reviewer,ratifier,verifier_v}.json (spec_writer/reviewer/ratifier all signed off on it), but it is narrower/incomplete: its guard only fires on the `graha` filter (`graha ? ... : leverageActive/unfiltered path`). The query also supports an independent `domain` filter (an EXISTS/CDLM-join WHERE clause at query_remedies.ts ~line 347-352, orthogonal to the graha filter) that collapses/narrows orderedResRows the same way — a domain-only-filtered call would still have hit the exact same #1-superlative bug under the par/night-F-50 fix. The version that actually shipped (main / codex branch) handles graha-only, domain-only, and graha+domain-combined filtering via a single `filteredScope` computation, closing the full defect class rather than the graha-only subset the ratified spec scoped itself to. So the fix that landed is objectively more complete than the one this campaign's own review chain had ratified, even though it did not go through that review chain.

review_notes: Independent read of the merged query_remedies.ts confirms the logic is sound: filteredScope is computed once and covers all three filter combinations (graha-only, domain-only, graha+domain); the honest wording ("X leads this {filteredScope}: priority class Y (rank Z of 9 chart-wide) — resonance_score W") replaces the prior unconditional "#1 remedy-priority target" claim only when a filter is active, and the unfiltered/leverage-ranked paths are untouched (verified via the regression-guard test asserting #1 + Venus still appear unfiltered). No new bugs found. One pre-existing, non-blocking cosmetic note carried over unchanged from both candidate branches: "of 9" is a hardcoded literal rather than a dynamic count of grahas in the chart — not a new defect introduced by this fix, not in scope for F-50, not worth a new PR by itself.
